explanation: At step 28 bodies 0 and 1 are touching (gap 0.005). Body1 high speed collision imparts impulse to controlled body0, whose speed jumps from 2.9 at step28 to 10.27 at step29. The controller velocity-error law computes force kp*(vcmd-dir - v) without clamping; with kp=26.76 the sudden velocity error yields 486.9 N > fmax 72.67. Counterfactual lowering kp to 5 eliminates violation for same steps, confirming force not properly limited to fmax after collision.
